rationale: Dylan is building AI-powered career guidance at Casey AI and brings hands-on technical curiosity in LLM applications (evidenced by his AI-Pathfinder research work), while Eric is a senior researcher at Anthropic working on large language models at the frontier. Dylan's domain expertise in edtech/career-AI combined with his TypeScript/Python stack and GTM perspective could offer Eric real-world context on how advanced LLM research translates to scaled consumer applications, while Eric's deep LLM research work directly informs the technical direction Casey AI needs to compete in vertical AI-SaaS.
intro_message: Dylan Bryan, meet Eric Cheng — Dylan's shipping AI career guidance and has serious technical depth in LLMs, and Eric's doing LLM research at Anthropic; you both think in systems and could sharpen each other on what's actually possible in production AI.
